text: Fear of flying, or aviophobia, is one of the most prevalent phobias, affecting approximately 3 to 5% of the population. Although air travel has become significantly safer, fear of flying continues to impact individuals’ social, professional, and personal lives, often leading to avoidance behaviors and significant distress. This qualitative study explores the causes, triggers, and coping strategies associated with fear of flying, focusing on participants from Türkiye.
source_label: A qualitative study on aviophobia and coping strategies
